Arm results are written to separate files (arms-*.jsonl, arm-*.pt) that the offline forecast step does not open before its forecasts are committed.

arms_base.liveness: cell_sweep: donor-0 V cell at every (span row, layer 4-27, KV head) into the recipient; consumer M[answer, donor-0 answer]; plus the relay row (largest summed answer-row attention mass outside t0, the span and the answer row) cells at layers 4-27 x KV and its all-layer V band
arms_base.coalition: the top 4 single V cells of the liveness sweep by |effect|: all 6 pairs (cell_sweep two-cell arms); interaction = pair - sum of singles
arms_base.cuts: answer row, all 28 layers: t0 zero (p=0) and mask (s=-1e4); relay row zero and mask
arms_base.code_swaps: L20 KV6 cell at the gt row replaced (checkpoint at t_j.L20.h, restore per arm): panel-mean, country-mean (other correct candidates of the bridge country), other-country-mean (seeded), city-family-mean (city items), donor 0; edited answer-row ports at L20-27 + logits captured for offline hop ladders
arms_base.two_by_two: payload x receiver via restore at t_j.L20.h: A = donor-0 cell, B = donor-0's answer-row h at L20 (receiver state; same length donors), A+B; interaction I = dM(A+B) - dM(A) - dM(B)
arms_base.knockout: items whose country has a named set (8 countries, >= 3 items; next/r1_items.json named_neurons, from Z2 ablate, in-sample): replace the named neurons' f at the answer row (L20-27) with the panel-mean f; vs (i) the same count of random neurons from the same layers (seeded), (ii) an answer-token-fixed null: the same count drawn from the top-5x neurons of the same layers ranked by |gamma (W_U[a]-W_U[b]) . W_down[:, i]| (direct answer-direction writers), named excluded

arms_hard: liveness sweep (span rows x L4-27 x KV, donor 0) and t0/relay zero/mask cuts as above; capture as above

offline.seal_first: from the captures only (native state, weights, pre-edit operands: donor cells, mean cells, cut closed forms, knock-out values), a first-order passive forecast of dM for every intervention arm: one reverse-mode pass of M through a float32 replica of the answer-row computation (other rows' K/V fixed from the capture, as set_cell semantics) gives dM/d o_l, dM/d h_20 and dM/d f_l; forecast = gradient . pre-edit operand change (P07 for cells, P09 for cuts, Delta f for knock-outs). The replica is validated against the captured ports (max |h_out replica - native| reported) before use. Forecasts are committed before any arms file is opened.
offline.then: score forecasts against native; contrast vs share ranking against the liveness sweep (Spearman); mask-cut closed form with the f32-renormalised p; relay detection from reads (contrast); K/V typing views; content strip vs causal-liveness strip; address rule (R_argmax: argmax over span rows of p[h12]+p[h13] at L20 excluding t0; R_last; R_first; random) against the gt row on the 114 hard items; declared-carrier readout (gt cell write through gamma W_U; countries, capitals co-readout, all-set) on the 114; B_answer pre-read at L20.h (and L20.h_out) on base and hard; hop ladders of the code swaps from the edited captures

predictions.P1_forecast: first-order passive forecast vs native dM: Spearman >= 0.8 over single liveness cells (pooled per item, median over items); for the donor code swap, sign-of-margin flip set mismatch <= 0.25 of base items; for t0 cuts the first-order forecast misses by > 50% of |dM| on most items (large edits)
predictions.P2_lifetime: memo job 4 falsifiers: first causal layer (single cell |dM| > 0.5) later than the content strip's first C by > 8 layers on >= 32/64 items -> content strip is not lifetime; single-cell strip empty outside L20 on < 48/64 -> the one-cell reading was site selection. Prediction: neither fires; first causal layer median L18-20
predictions.P3_contrast_ranking: Spearman(contrast-form contribution, liveness effect) over sites >= 0.3 (median over items), above the share form's (entry 1: 0.10)
predictions.P4_cuts: mask-cut closed form with f32-renormalised p within 2 bf16 spacings on >= 0.9 of items (FT1 failure explained); relay-row band transplant moves dM by > 0.5 of the cell transplant on < 16/64 items (no hidden relay)
predictions.P5_code: J1 predictions J1a-J1e of next/prereg_j1.json, judged here (country-mean |dM| < panel-mean |dM| on >= 48/63; country-mean keeps the answer on >= 44/47 non-city items with members, >= 12/16 city; content after swaps: country unchanged >= 0.9 with country-mean; other-country-mean names the other country >= 0.8 and flips to its capital >= 0.3)
predictions.P6_two_by_two: |I| <= 0.25 |dM(A)| on >= 0.6 of items (payload and receiver mostly additive)
predictions.P7_coalition: pairs of the top cells are sub-additive (|pair| < |sum of singles|) on >= 0.6 of pairs (redundant copies)
predictions.P8_knockout: named-set |dM| exceeds the random set's by >= 2 floors (0.5) on >= 0.6 of eligible items, and exceeds the answer-token-fixed null's on >= 0.5; if it does not beat the answer-token null, the recurrence is the answer token's, not the bridge's
